metadata.name: Get Confident Peaks From ChIP_PE duplicates (release v0.6)
annotations: This workflow takes as input PE BAM from ChIP-seq. It calls peaks on each replicate and intersect them. In parallel, each BAM is subsetted to smallest number of reads. Peaks are called using both subsets combined. Only peaks called using a combination of both subsets which have summits intersecting the intersection of both replicates will be kept.
